entries.name: Schottky diode
entries.summary: A metal-semiconductor diode used for rectification or clamping with device-specific forward and reverse characteristics.

entries.name: Unidirectional TVS diode
entries.summary: A transient-suppression diode intended to clamp a documented surge polarity across a protected circuit.

entries.name: Light-emitting diode
entries.summary: A semiconductor diode that emits light when operated with the appropriate forward current.

entries.name: Varactor diode
entries.summary: A reverse-biased diode whose junction capacitance is used as a voltage-controlled circuit element.

entries.name: PIN diode
entries.summary: A diode structure used in applications such as RF switching or attenuation with a documented bias circuit.

entries.name: NPN bipolar transistor
entries.summary: A bipolar transistor with base, collector and emitter terminals arranged for NPN operation.

entries.name: PNP bipolar transistor
entries.summary: A bipolar transistor with base, collector and emitter terminals arranged for PNP operation.

entries.name: NPN Darlington transistor
entries.summary: Two NPN transistor stages connected as a Darlington pair to provide a combined current-amplifying device.

entries.name: PNP Darlington transistor
entries.summary: Two PNP transistor stages connected as a compound current-amplifying device.

entries.name: N-channel JFET
entries.summary: A junction field-effect transistor using an N-type channel controlled through a gate junction.

entries.name: P-channel JFET
entries.summary: A junction field-effect transistor using a P-type channel and the corresponding gate-bias polarity.

entries.name: N-channel enhancement MOSFET
entries.summary: An insulated-gate transistor whose N-channel conduction is enabled by the documented gate-to-source drive.

entries.name: P-channel enhancement MOSFET
entries.summary: An insulated-gate transistor using a P-channel and the corresponding gate-to-source drive polarity.

entries.name: N-channel depletion MOSFET
entries.summary: An N-channel insulated-gate device that conducts at zero gate-to-source voltage according to its device characteristics.

entries.name: Insulated-gate bipolar transistor
entries.summary: A power transistor combining insulated-gate control with a bipolar collector-emitter conduction structure.

entries.name: MOSFET body diode
entries.summary: The intrinsic diode associated with a MOSFET's semiconductor structure, often shown within the device reference.

entries.name: GaN enhancement-mode HEMT
entries.summary: A normally-off gallium-nitride high-electron-mobility transistor used as a controlled power switch.

entries.name: Integrated gate-commutated thyristor
entries.summary: A high-power thyristor device operated with an integrated gate-unit arrangement for controlled switching.

entries.name: NPN phototransistor
entries.summary: An NPN transistor whose collector-emitter conduction responds to incident light in the documented detector arrangement.

entries.name: Phototransistor optocoupler
entries.summary: An optical isolation component using an input light emitter and a transistor output on the isolated side.

entries.name: Photodiode optocoupler
entries.summary: An optically coupled component using photodiode output sensing for an isolation or feedback arrangement.

entries.name: Phototriac optocoupler
entries.summary: An optical isolation device whose output is a light-triggered triac-type switching element.

entries.name: Photovoltaic MOSFET driver
entries.summary: An optical component producing an isolated photovoltaic output used to drive a MOSFET gate circuit.

entries.name: Capacitive digital isolator
entries.summary: Transfers digital information between separately referenced electrical domains through a capacitive isolation structure.

entries.name: Isolated gate driver
entries.summary: Transfers a switching command across an isolation barrier and drives a power-transistor gate circuit.

entries.name: Low-side gate driver
entries.summary: Provides gate-drive current for a power switch referenced to the driver's low-side return.

entries.name: High-side gate driver
entries.summary: Drives a high-side power transistor with the output circuit referenced to its switching node.

entries.name: Bootstrap gate-drive supply
entries.summary: A diode-capacitor arrangement used to supply a floating high-side gate-driver circuit under documented switching conditions.

entries.name: Ideal-diode controller
entries.summary: Controls an external transistor to obtain the documented low-loss directional or reverse-blocking power path.

entries.name: Hot-swap controller
entries.summary: Controls a power path during equipment insertion or power-up to manage the documented inrush sequence.

entries.name: Electronic fuse IC
entries.summary: An integrated semiconductor power-path device providing the selected current-limiting and protection functions.

entries.name: Half-bridge power module
entries.summary: A packaged power-switch arrangement forming one half-bridge switching leg.

entries.name: Three-phase sixpack power module
entries.summary: A power module containing three switching legs for a three-phase bridge arrangement.

entries.name: Magnetic digital isolator
entries.summary: A magnetic digital isolator transfers digital information across its isolation barrier using magnetic coupling.

entries.name: Isolated comparator
entries.summary: An isolated comparator evaluates an input condition and transfers its comparison result across an isolation barrier.

entries.name: Power-source multiplexer
entries.summary: A power multiplexer selects between defined supply paths feeding an output.

entries.name: Reverse-polarity protection controller
entries.summary: A reverse-polarity protection controller manages a power path against a specified reversed connection condition.

entries.name: Integrated load switch
entries.summary: An integrated load switch connects or disconnects a supply path under an enable or control signal.

entries.name: Smart high-side switch
entries.summary: A high-side switch controls the connection between a supply and the high side of a load.

entries.name: Low-side power switch
entries.summary: A low-side switch controls the return-side connection of a load in its specified circuit.

entries.name: Linear voltage regulator
entries.summary: A linear regulator controls its pass element to maintain a specified output voltage from a suitable input.

entries.name: Low-dropout voltage regulator
entries.summary: An LDO is a linear voltage regulator designed to operate with its specified small input-to-output voltage headroom.
